# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Pharaoh Blesses the Marriage; Jacob Comes

---

**16:1** And in those days Pharaoh sent to Joseph saying: 'Come to me at once, for the daughter of Potiphar the priest of Heliopolis is betrothed to you, and she is a virgin who has not known any man, and her name is Aseneth, and she will be your wife.'

**16:2** And Joseph went to Pharaoh and stood before him, and Pharaoh saw him and rejoiced greatly and kissed him on the mouth.

**16:3** And Pharaoh summoned Pentephres and said to him: 'Bring your daughter Aseneth to me.' And Pentephres came with Aseneth and brought her before Pharaoh.

**16:4** And Pharaoh saw Aseneth and was amazed at her beauty and said: 'Blessed is the Lord God of Joseph who has chosen you for him, for you are beautiful and good and a pure virgin, and Joseph is mighty in wisdom and power, and I will betroth you to him today and he shall be your husband for ever.'

**16:5** And Pharaoh took the golden crowns and placed them on both their heads and joined their right hands together and said: 'The Lord God Most High will bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you and glorify you for ever and ever.'

**16:6** And he said: 'Go into your chambers.' And Joseph went in with Aseneth, and they feasted and drank wine.

**16:7** And Joseph knew Aseneth, and she conceived and bore Manasseh and his brother Ephraim in the house of Joseph.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
